HEAD already did half of this. The host carries on alone when the link drops, and a player 2 window that boots finds the pair again by itself. If player 1's window dies, player 2 takes over the raid. Nothing opened a closed player 2 window again, so TV 2 stayed dark and later runs were 1 player.

What I added:
- **Closed window:** once player 2 has been linked and the link is gone for 3 seconds, the host opens the window again at the same pair address. Player 2 then presses A to join the live run or the next one.
- **Open but dead window:** it is reloaded after 10 seconds, but not if it is holding its own raid.
- **Blocked popup:** Chrome opens a window only after a key press. If it blocks the open, the host retries every 2.5 seconds, so the next key press by player 1 gets through.
- **Feed line:** it says "player 2 window reopening".
- **Scope:** this only runs in the 2 player demo, so the 1 player demo and normal raids are untouched.

**Watch on the next playtest:** close the player 2 window mid-run. The window should come back within a few seconds. If it doesn't, press a movement key in the player 1 window. DESIGN.md has this note too.
